exceptions.reason: picomatch ReDoS through single-branch repeated extglobs. No patched release exists: the advisory covers every published version (<= 4.0.7, the latest), and the only npm-proposed fix downgrades awilix to 6.0.0. It reaches production only through awilix > fast-glob > micromatch, where awilix globs file names solely inside loadModules() and listModules(). This repo registers every binding explicitly (packages/core/src/container/container.ts) and a unit test forbids those calls, so no attacker-controlled pattern reaches picomatch. Re-check by the expiry date: npm view picomatch version.
